offers_products.reason: Sells data, credit scores, analytics software and subscription credit monitoring/ID protection products to lenders and consumers.

offers_services.reason: Provides verification of employment/income, identity protection, fraud and payroll-related services, and analytical services for businesses and government.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells monthly credit monitoring and ID theft protection subscriptions and credit reports directly to consumers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Lenders, automakers, utilities, insurers, employers and government agencies buy credit data, verifications and analytics.

recurring_revenue.reason: Lenders and employers repeatedly buy credit files and verifications; consumers pay monthly subscriptions; contracts are ongoing.

cyclical_demand.reason: Volumes tied to mortgage, auto and credit originations and hiring, which fall in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Credit reports, verifications and monthly subscriptions are small, frequent transactions.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from proprietary data, analytics and cloud technology platforms, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main revenue from large lenders, banks, insurers, telecoms, employers and government agencies, though consumer subscriptions also exist.

asset_heavy.reason: Data and technology business; cloud and data investment is significant but no plants, fleets or property networks.
